malware.name: GhostPresser
malware.description: GhostPresser is a tool associated with the GhostSec threat group. It functions as an admin bypass and hacking tool specifically targeting the WordPress content management system. This shell script was allegedly utilized by GhostSec in an XSS attack against legitimate websites.<sup>[[Cisco Talos Blog March 5 2024](/references/bcdd2d44-a47a-4749-b61b-025086011f17)]</sup>

malware.name: GhostSec Deep Scan Tool
malware.description: The GhostSec deep scan toolset is a Python utility that an attacker can use to scan the websites of their potential targets.<sup>[[Cisco Talos Blog March 5 2024](/references/bcdd2d44-a47a-4749-b61b-025086011f17)]</sup>

malware.name: GhostLocker
malware.description: GhostLocker is a sophisticated ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) framework developed by the GhostSec hacktivist group and promoted through a Telegram channel at an initial price of $999.00. The ransomware builder offers several options to select from such as kill processes, disable services, ransom amount, directories to encrypt, remove background, and delete malicious binaries.<sup>[[Cisco Talos Blog March 5 2024](/references/bcdd2d44-a47a-4749-b61b-025086011f17)]</sup><sup>[[SOCRadar® Cyber Intelligence Inc. October 18 2023](/references/088091e9-4c9c-44ed-99e6-0489eec57c98)]</sup><sup>[[Uptycs Inc November 3 2023](/references/2a3638f7-86a0-41e5-a3f3-ad2918cb4ad4)]</sup>

tools.name: Telegram
tools.description: Telegram is a global instant messaging service that is utilized by threat actors and other users for various malicious and benign purposes. Among the many features telegram provides to its no malicious clients, the API and BOT functionalities can and is abused by threat actors as means to deploy malware and/or exfiltrate data. Due to the service's high usage it is often unblocked and not monitored, providing to an attacker an easy way to bypass network restrictions.<sup>[[Telegram December 4 2024](/references/2624b235-c94f-414f-8728-4a4333ff45bf)]</sup>

tools.name: Nuitka
tools.description: Nuitka is a seamless replacement or extension to the Python interpreter and compiles every construct that CPython 2.6, 2.7, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10 have, when itself run with that Python version. It then executes uncompiled code and compiled code together in an extremely compatible manner.<sup>[[Cyble July 14 2022](/references/f23b79ca-2108-4096-8fc9-a2d6e9029f06)]</sup><sup>[[GitHub April 23 2013](/references/afb66212-8cbb-4c5d-8a85-027275c5cb01)]</sup><sup>[[Trend Micro March 30 2023](/references/e78b7c32-9b1d-4d5e-8f38-6d6778ee056b)]</sup>

tools.name: Tor
tools.description: [Tor](https://app.tidalcyber.com/software/8c70d85b-b06d-423c-8bab-ecff18f332d6) is a software suite and network that provides increased anonymity on the Internet. It creates a multi-hop proxy network and utilizes multilayer encryption to protect both the message and routing information. [Tor](https://app.tidalcyber.com/software/8c70d85b-b06d-423c-8bab-ecff18f332d6) utilizes "Onion Routing," in which messages are encrypted with multiple layers of encryption; at each step in the proxy network, the topmost layer is decrypted and the contents forwarded on to the next node until it reaches its destination. <sup>[[Dingledine Tor The Second-Generation Onion Router](https://app.tidalcyber.com/references/ffb6a26d-2da9-4cce-bb2d-5280e9cc16b4)]</sup>

tools.name: WatchDog
tools.description: WatchDog is a simple program that uses watchdog to monitor directories specified as command-line arguments and logs events generated.<sup>[[GitHub October 23 2010](/references/4de5bd9d-ebb7-42b4-81d9-279433e86434)]</sup>

tools.name: python.exe
tools.description:
The genuine python.exe file is a software component of Python by Python Software Foundation.
Python is a high-level programming language which supports object-oriented, imperative and functional programming or procedural programming styles. Python.exe launches the Python application.<sup>[[python.exe Windows process July 2 2014](/references/ab0acab9-706f-47ed-966f-b0249276cafd)]</sup>
